integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and standard-library numerical checker; finite checks supplement but cannot certify the infinite proof. No independent validation or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic for sufficiently large unit-weight cycles; no finite small-order census, no all-time sign-window classification, and no extension to weighted graphs or higher-dimensional tori. Bibliographic priority requires independent confirmation.
title: Parity splitting in the eventual positivity horizon of cyclic biharmonic heat
